Hi Sara — great to hear EagleTech is kicking the tires. We typically auto-issue a self-serve promo grant for corporate domains after a quick automated check, but for larger cohorts I flag for a short manual review to avoid promo abuse.

I started a quick audit and attached the signups you sent. Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm these signups are for distinct employees (not role/shared accounts)?
- Any expected spike in parallel requests from CI or automated test accounts?

If it looks like a normal cohort I can approve the $1,000 evaluation credit pool and set a 30-day expiry. Looping in Marissa on the approval side.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-05-07T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Trial credits request for evaluation

Jordan / Priyom — I reviewed the signup sample. Quick flags from fraud signals:
- 18 signups in 24 hours, 12 from emails using the pattern dev+<number>@eagletech.com
- 9 accounts staged from a narrow IP range that geolocates to an ISP commonly used by cloud CI hosts
- Several accounts show identical user-agent strings and identical created_at timestamps within 2–3s windows

I attached a screenshot of the IP overlap and a short audit excerpt. My recommendation: hold credit issuance and request corporate verification (OKTA or MSA PO) before granting the full pool. We can offer a single test account with limited credits for now.

Marissa
Senior SDR Ops — Redwood Inference

Hi Sara — quick update and an ask. Our ops team surfaced some suspicious patterns in the signup batch (attached). To keep the trial moving while we clear this, we can do one of two things quickly:

Option A — Fast path: Provide a single seeded demo account with 100 USD of credits (short expiry). This lets your engineers validate flows without exposing a large promo pool.

Option B — Corporate verification: Share a company PO or a link to your SSO domain verification (Okta/Google Workspace admin confirmation). Once verified, we can approve the full $1,000 pool for the cohort.

Which option works for you? If you send over the admin contact or a short confirmation from your IT security, I can expedite.

Best,
Jordan
